documents.title: B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 Programme — Sunday, 15 November 2026
documents.content: B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 is a one-day celebration on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at Brigade 7 Gardens (it was earlier planned for 31 October and 1 November). The morning session runs from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM (arrival of guests, breakfast with the Chief Guests, invocation and lamp lighting, welcome address, Samvada with the Chief Guests, and the inauguration of B7G Santhe at 10:45 AM; Santhe stays open until the evening). The evening session (cultural programme) starts at 4:40 PM with performances by B7G residents, followed by sand art by Mr. Raghavendra Hegde from 7:05 PM to 8:00 PM and jamming from 8:45 PM to 10:30 PM.

documents.title: B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 — Sunday, 15 November 2026 Morning Session
documents.content:
The morning session (Morning Session) of B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 on Sunday, 15 November 2026 runs from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM and has 7 items, in this order:
1. 8:30 AM – 8:45 AM: Arrival of Guests
2. 8:45 AM – 9:00 AM: Breakfast with the Chief Guests
3. 9:10 AM – 9:15 AM: Invocation Song by Poornima & Lamp Lighting Ceremony
4. 9:20 AM – 9:25 AM: Welcome Address by the President
5. 9:30 AM – 10:30 AM: Samvada (Interaction with the Chief Guests)
6. 10:30 AM – 10:45 AM: Chief Guests Interaction with GSS Team
